nativePlatform.textDimensions: sp through MaterialTheme.typography and Android font scaling
nativePlatform.themeSelection: isSystemInDarkTheme() selects the explicit Light or Dark color scheme; system bar icon appearance follows that selection.
nativePlatform.componentEncoding: Native component descriptors and source evidence are recorded below. No HTML/CSS preview or web rendering approximation is generated.
nativePlatform.colorEncoding: Primitives live only in DESIGN.md frontmatter. No tonal ramps are synthesized: the shipped app defines paired light/dark semantic schemes, not an eight-step ramp.
nativePlatform.inheritedDefaults: MaterialTheme receives a colorScheme only. Typography, Shapes, native state layers, disabled colors, and unspecified scheme roles retain Material 3 defaults.

nativeLayout.root: Scaffold with TopAppBar, SnackbarHost, root-only NavigationBar, and nonempty-library ExtendedFloatingActionButton
nativeLayout.scrolling: LazyColumn for library; vertically scrolling Column for editor, detail, settings, and NFC
nativeLayout.insets: Scaffold content padding is applied and consumed; content uses imePadding; editor save bar uses navigationBarsPadding and imePadding.

nativeElevation.name: material-components
nativeElevation.purpose: Floating action button, dialogs, snackbar, and native state treatment.

nativeMotion.behavior: No custom motion timing or easing is defined. Native Material touch feedback and state/progress behavior are retained.

nativeComponents.name: Primary Button
nativeComponents.description: Full-width primary action with native pill shape, labelLarge, primary/onPrimary colors, and a growing minimum height.
nativeComponents.behavior: Native touch, focus, and disabled states. Save/import actions respect storage and busy states; NFC actions require enabled hardware.

nativeComponents.name: Outlined Button
nativeComponents.description: Full-width secondary action with native outline and pill shape.
nativeComponents.behavior: Uses native focus and disabled treatment; importing replaces its icon with CircularProgressIndicator and changes its label.

nativeComponents.name: Text Button
nativeComponents.description: Supporting links and dialog actions use native primary-colored text and state layers.

nativeComponents.name: Outlined Field
nativeComponents.description: Column-width native field with label, placeholder, keyboard type, and multiline notes variant.
nativeComponents.behavior: Notes use 3 minimum and 6 maximum lines; URL fields use KeyboardType.Uri. No custom inline error appearance is defined.

nativeComponents.name: Root Navigation
nativeComponents.description: Three icon-and-label destinations with native selection emphasis and a native top app bar.
nativeComponents.behavior: Root routes show bottom navigation. Detail/editor use the app-bar back action. System bar foreground appearance tracks the device theme.

nativeComponents.name: NFC Filter Chip
nativeComponents.description: Native selected tonal container and unselected outline distinguish NFC modes and payload types.
nativeComponents.behavior: Mode changes stop scans; payload-type chips disable while a scan is active.

nativeComponents.name: Pass Card
nativeComponents.description: Flat colored pass with padded identity header and edge-to-edge artwork below it.
nativeComponents.behavior: User-selected color persists across app themes. Foreground is white or dark ink by luminance. Artwork uses ContentScale.Fit; compact views omit the QR block. Detail adds the QR bitmap.

nativeComponents.name: Create Pass Floating Action
nativeComponents.description: Native tonal floating action with outlined Add vector and text label.
nativeComponents.behavior: Appears in the nonempty library; the empty library uses its full-width primary action.

nativeComponents.name: Native Feedback
nativeComponents.description: Native feedback for busy, saved, unavailable, destructive, and error states.
nativeComponents.behavior: Local-save wording stays explicit. Wallet fallback reports a saved image and import instructions, without asserting a completed Wallet import. NFC actions disable when unavailable; settings link requires supported-but-off hardware.

evidence.scope: Documentation only. Implementation, build outputs, and screenshot files were not changed. Native captures verify appearance; source defines the recorded values and behavior.

narrative.overview:
The user's picture is the expressive material. Cool surfaces, dark ink, cobalt actions, and a compact native control vocabulary frame that material without competing with it. The built app uses a centered, single-column composition with generous page margins and clear saved-state text.

This is a native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose system. Material 3 supplies typography, control shapes, state layers, dialogs, and navigation. System typography is an intentional Android platform choice. The build is the authority for the values below.
keyCharacteristics: Personal artwork provides the visual variety.
Paired light and dark schemes follow the device setting.
Native controls retain familiar touch, focus, and disabled behavior.
Flat pass cards sit within a quiet, spacious single column.
Labels distinguish local saving from a handoff to Google Wallet.

rules.name: The Artwork Owns Color Rule
rules.body: Keep application chrome on its semantic theme roles; preserve the selected pass color and full-color artwork in light and dark mode.

rules.name: The Native Type Rule
rules.body: Reuse Material typography roles and allow Android font scaling; do not replace them with fixed bitmap or web typography in the app.

rules.name: The Top and Scroll Rule
rules.body: Preserve top-aligned, inset-aware scrolling when adding content or supporting larger font scales.

dos: **Do** let the user's artwork and pass color provide visual variety.
**Do** reuse Material components, typography roles, and semantic theme colors.
**Do** keep the centered column, repeated page gutters, and top-aligned scrolling.
**Do** preserve native focus, touch, disabled, progress, and font-scale behavior.
**Do** name local-save, busy, error, and hardware states explicitly.
donts: **Don't** crop or recolor uploaded artwork to fit the application palette.
**Don't** treat a Google Wallet image handoff as a confirmed Wallet save.
**Don't** enable scan/write actions when NFC is unavailable or off.
**Don't** replace the native Android system with website styling or web component approximations.
